# SpiceRoutes

> > Luxury houseboat experiences in Kerala's backwaters with a commitment to responsible tourism and sustainable practices.

SpiceRoutes offers premium houseboat accommodations in the Alleppey and Kuttanad regions of Kerala, combining traditional backwater experiences with modern amenities while prioritizing eco-friendly operations, waste management, and local community employment.

## Key Topics

- Kerala backwaters
- Luxury houseboats
- Alleppey
- Kuttanad
- Chennamkary
- Responsible tourism
- Sustainable practices
- Waste management
- Single-use plastic ban
- Local employment
- Organic food sourcing
- Eco-friendly accommodations
- Traditional Kerala hospitality

- [Accommodation 2](https://spiceroutes.in/accommodation/accommodation-2): Houseboat accommodation with amenities, rates, and video tour

- [Responsible Tourism in Kerala – Sustainable Luxury Houseboats](https://spiceroutes.in/responsible-tourism): Eco-friendly Kerala houseboats with waste management & sustainable practices
